title: Moving embedded game to different monitor with keyboard shortcut detaches it from workspace window
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in 4.5.1-stable and 4.6-rc1 ### System information Windows 11 - dual monitor, both 2560 x 1440 ### Issue description In Windows, you can quickly move the currently focused window to the previous or next screen with Win+Shift+Left and Win+Shift+Right. If your project runs embedded in a floating game workspace, and the game (not the toolbar or outer window) has focus, then using these shortcuts moves the embedded game to another monitor without moving the workspace window (where the game toolbar is). Focusing on the workspace window makes it embed the game again. This doesn't happen if you explicitly focus the workspace window instead by clicking the title bar or anywhere in the toolbar. However, the embedded game gains focus on startup automatically, and gains focus by merely moving the cursor over the game if the workspace window has focus. ### Steps to reproduce * Requires a multi-monitor setup * Enable _Embed Game on Next Play_ and _Make Game Workspace Floating on Next Play_ * Run game, and then press Win+Shift+Left/Right to move window to a different monitor ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Reproducible with any project.
